headline: Knee-to-waist SE, glassy at dawn — a quick log before work.
today: Same story as Rockaway just smaller: 1.1-1.2ft at 6s on a prime angle, cleanest from first light through a light ENE morning breeze. Get on it before the SE cross-on shows up in the afternoon. Longboard only, and keep expectations low.

daysToWatch.note: Swell builds to 3.2ft but morning's blown cross at 13mph — the play is the evening when it drops to a light SW 4mph. Rockaway will be the better call this day, but Lido cleans up at dusk if you're local.
Small but 8.4s SSE prime angle with a light NE cross-off at dawn. Clean waist-high longboard window if the tide lines up.
